svg.title: An agent's path through a site map
svg.desc: A question — how much does an AI agent cost, and when does it pay off — answered by opening four small notes in turn: the site map, the page about agent cost, its section on model cost, and a similar section on payback from another page. Other pages and sections listed along the way stay closed.
svg.text: AGENT-SITEMAP · FIG. 1 · ONE QUESTION, FOUR NOTES
How much does an AI agent cost, and when does it pay off?

text.tspan: The agent reads a map, not the site: every link says what is behind it and how many tokens it costs.

svg.text: Oxblood: notes the agent opened. Grey: notes it saw listed and skipped. Example from the map of deckardlab.tech; titles and paths translated from Russian.
